Of course, if one mate were far better than the rest, there would be no need to explore—the choice would be obvious. vocabulary.example: The list included a hundred potential applicants.

questions.translation: 当潜在配偶数设为 1,000 时，只先搜索 3% 这一更简略的做法，找到前 10% 对象的概率最高。换句话说，若有 100 个潜在对象，你只需仔细考察前 14 个，再选随后遇到的、比前 14 个中最佳者更好的人。
questions.editorialStatus: 完整PDF106–111原页视觉核对及跨页拼接；CDC关联不作因果保证；100/1000候选、14%/3%与前10%目标分开。费城许可证、荷兰个人筛选与MIT友谊提名单位分开，众数/中位数与测量时点不混用；Cupid为比喻；宿舍随机背景按作者概括保留，不冒充完整随机试验方案。功能距离研究与后续曝光机制实验分开。末段完整审阅含未配题词频比较，未声称全书逐句证据覆盖。

questions.passage: When the number of potential mates is set to 1,000, an even more cursory search of just 3 percent yields the highest probability of finding someone from the top 10 percent. In other words, if there were 100 potential mates, you would only need to look at the first 14 mates carefully and then pick the next mate that is better than the best one from the first 14.
questions.prompt: For a pool of 1,000, what initial search proportion is reported for finding a top-ten-percent option?
questions.promptZh: 候选池1,000时，为找到前10%一项，所报初始搜索比例是多少？
options: Fourteen percent, the proportion from the 100-option case.
Thirty-seven percent under every possible success criterion.
Three percent.
Ten percent simply because the quality target is the top ten percent.
optionsZh: 100项情形中的14%。
不论成功标准都为37%。
因目标前10%所以搜索也10%。
analyses: A 将100项条件的14%挪给1,000项。
B 不同成功标准已改变策略，不能坚持全情境37%。
C set to1,000、just3percent、top10percent 三要素对应，不能混同池规模和质量阈值。
D top10%是质量目标，不是初始考察比例；模型概率最高也不是每次必成功。

vocabulary.meaning: 较简略的；不作同等广泛考察的
vocabulary.context: 此处指初始搜索量更少，不等于文中已证明粗心必胜或无需比较。
vocabulary.example: The revised model allowed a more cursory initial search.
